task: Add a @deprecated GC advisory rule to the Lattice audit system: scan source for @deprecated annotations at audit time, and append a cleanup advisory to the audit hint when count exceeds a configurable threshold.
outcome: After N stories are DONE and the audit trigger fires, the user sees a new line in the audit hint: '⚠ @deprecated GC: 12 annotation(s) in 3 file(s) (guard-session.ts, types.ts, ...); consider a cleanup story (threshold: 10)'. When count is below threshold (currently 7 < 10), the advisory does not appear — audit hint is unchanged.
facts: audit-trigger.ts fires via doneSinceLastAudit counter in .lattice/runtime/framework-audit/state.json
audit-config.ts already reads .lattice/audit-config.json for per-field overrides (auditTriggerWindow etc.)
audit-scan.ts has scanCommandDrift/scanFlagDrift/scanPathDrift as the pattern to follow
Current @deprecated count in packages/main/src: 7 lines in 2 files (guard-session.ts, types.ts)
AuditTriggerResult.hint is the additive string field for user-facing advisory text
constraints: Advisory is additive only — never blocks DONE, never changes triggered=false
Must not throw — wrap scanDeprecated in try/catch, return count=0 on error
deprecatedGcThreshold default: 10 (so current 7 annotations do not fire immediately)
New field deprecatedGcThreshold must follow exact same per-field override pattern as auditTriggerWindow
unknowns: Whether audit-trigger.ts calls audit-scan functions directly or via audit.ts handler — need to trace call path before wiring
